title: Let's Play SpAIceRocks
author: CeruleanSpirit123
selftext:
[SpA.I.ce Rocks](https://preview.redd.it/e1vh1k0fj45f1.png?width=800&format=png&auto=webp&s=7484d6b113191e91c51715a176d993553651df19)

  
Hi r/aigamedev! My Cerulean Spirit Let’s Play explores Chris Harden's SpAIceRocks.

[https://youtu.be/Yal8VKkoFs0](https://youtu.be/Yal8VKkoFs0)

SpAIceRocks is a good class in AI driven indie gamedev. First the source code of the game is available on Github:

[https://github.com/chrisaharden/SpAIceRocks](https://github.com/chrisaharden/SpAIceRocks)

Chris Harden is a programmer at Games, Entertainment, and Technologies team at [Unity Technologies](https://unity.com/). He has created a bunch of video explaining the process of creating the game with various tools like Midjourney, Udio, Claude, Cline...
